exposure: spontaneous preterm birth with histologic chorioamnionitis
outcome: miRNA and mRNA expression profiles in myometrial biopsies
Differentially expressed miRNAs and their target genes
Protein expression of MEF2A and MEF2C in myometrium
cohort: Pregnant women undergoing primary Cesarean deliveries in four clinical scenarios (spontaneous term labor, term nonlabor, spontaneous preterm birth with chorioamnionitis, indicated preterm birth nonlabor)
finding: Integrated transcriptomics network analyses identified altered expression of myocyte enhancer factor-2 (MEF2) transcription factors, potentially regulated by miRNAs, as a possible molecular mechanism contributing to the transition from myometrial quiescence to labor.
